from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np
import scipy.stats as stats

# Prepare the data for regression
X = hispanic_men[['DISSAVED', 'SAMESAVE']].values  # Predictor variables
y = hispanic_men['BMI'].values  # Response variable

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficients and standard errors
coefficients = model.coef_
std_errors = np.sqrt(np.diag(model.score(X, y) * np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)))

# Calculate t-statistics and p-values
t_statistics = coefficients / std_errors
p_values = 2 * (1 - stats.t.cdf(np.abs(t_statistics), len(hispanic_men) - X.shape[1] - 1))

p_values
